title: An insight into the suitability of magnesium ion-conducting biodegradable methyl cellulose solid polymer electrolyte film in energy storage devices
Material_Name: Biodegradable solid polymer electrolyte based on methyl cellulose and magnesium acetate
materials_context:
## Key Contributions
- **Novel materials or compounds**: Methyl cellulose and magnesium acetate tetrahydrate-based biodegradable solid polymer electrolyte films.
- **Unique synthesis methods**: Conventional solution casting technique for the preparation of biodegradable solid polymer electrolyte films.
- **Specific applications or domains**: Energy storage devices, specifically in the construction of magnesium ion-conducting primary batteries.
